::: callout-note
## What you'll learn about
Two more disciplined dialects: **Disciplined Geometric Programming** (DGP) for
posynomial/log-log-convex problems, and **Disciplined Quasiconvex Programming**
(DQCP) for quasiconvex objectives.
:::
